_shardCount_note: Empirically validated on this machine (see README): 5 parallel k6 containers x up to 100/s offered each (500/s total) runs clean (0 request_errors, 0 dropped_iterations). 20 shards at a higher per-shard rate caused the GENERATOR to collapse (88% connection failures, 108k dropped_iterations) well before the backend showed any real strain -- see docs/loadtest-results for that run's numbers, kept as a documented finding, not the baseline.
